india.one_line: India advances AI data governance and hardware investment with new DEPA handbook and CapGrid funding.

themes.title: DEPA handbook guides data sharing
themes.text: MeitY released a handbook on the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture, outlining a techno‑legal framework that lets institutions share data for AI training while retaining control through contractual permissions, clean rooms and privacy safeguards.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training

themes.title: CapGrid secures ₹50 cr for drones
themes.text: CapGrid raised ₹50 cr in a pre‑Series B round led by Hero Enterprise Venture Partners, valuing it at ₹430 cr and earmarking the funds for R&D on precision components, drone manufacturing and data‑centre expansion.

stories.headline: CapGrid raises ₹50 cr funding, valued at ₹430 cr to expand into drones and data centres
